locus_A: Table S1 (SI .docx): code 113 = "N'-methyl-2,2'-diaminodiethylamine" (TCI). That name is bis(2-aminoethyl)METHYLamine, CAS 4097-88-5: the central nitrogen carries a methyl.
locus_B: Figure 1B draws head 113 as H2N-CH2CH2-NH-CH2CH2-NH2, i.e. diethylenetriamine, with an explicit H on the central nitrogen and no methyl. Verified at 4x on the 300 dpi raster.
third_witness: The corpus already holds this head independently: KL_2010's IL_head_name '113' carries IL_head_SMILES 'CN(CCN)CCN', which is the NAME's structure, not the drawing's.
we_emitted: the Table S1 name (CN(CCN)CCN). 20 of 580 structures.
why: These are catalogue reagents bought under a vendor name; a vendor ships what the name says, and a second independent curation of the same numbered head agrees with the name. BUT the choice changes the N-H count from 4 to 5 and therefore the number of tails, which is a structural claim no mass or formula can test. DECISIONS.md D-1.

locus_A: Table S1: code 200 = "N1-(2-(4-(2-aminoethyl)piperazin-1-yl)ETHYL)ethane-1,2-diamine" (Enamine). The name puts a TWO-carbon bridge between the piperazine nitrogen and the secondary NH.
locus_B: Figure 1B draws ONE methylene there: piperazine-N-CH2-NH-CH2CH2-NH2. That is an aminal (N-CH2-N), which is not a stable isolable amine and is not what Enamine sells.
we_emitted: the Table S1 name (NCCNCCN1CCN(CCN)CC1). 20 of 580 structures; 3 of the 49 emitted rows (200O10, 200O12, 200Oi10).
why: The IUPAC name is unambiguous and the drawn alternative is chemically implausible. DECISIONS.md D-1.

locus_A: Table S1: code 303 = "N,N-Dimethyldipropylenetriamine" (Sigma, CAS 10563-29-8) = Me2N-(CH2)3-NH-(CH2)3-NH2: two THREE-carbon arms.
locus_B: Figure 1B draws H2N-(CH2)3-NH-CH2-NMe2 -- the second arm is a single methylene, again an aminal.
we_emitted: the Table S1 name (CN(C)CCCNCCCN). 20 of 580 structures; 2 of the 49 emitted rows (303X2, 303Oi10).
why: Same reasoning as C-2. The two drawings share a failure mode -- a propylene drawn as a methylene -- which suggests a single figure-drawing slip rather than two chemistries. DECISIONS.md D-1.

locus_B: The Figure 3C pie the same authors drew: lung 40.58%, spleen 34.53%, liver 24.89%. Measured as ANGULAR span at 0.6 R over 3600 rays, 0 unresolved, sectors summing to 100.000%.

claim: 'two new highly potent LNPs (402O8,12 and 500O6,10) with total luminescence efficacy over 10^9 p/s'
third_witness: Upper error bars: exactly those three reach 10^9 and no fourth does.
we_emitted: the bar top (the mean), as the corpus stores means.
why: The threshold was applied to mean+SD. Not an error, but the stored value for 500O6,10 is 8.1e8 and a reader comparing it to the sentence will see a mismatch. See C-8, which pins the same reading independently.

claim: 'An additional 13 LNPs were identified with total luminescence over 10^8 p/s'
locus_B: Figure 2B bar tops: 11 lipidoids reach 10^8, i.e. 8 'additional' beyond the three named.
third_witness: Upper error bars: 16 reach 10^8, i.e. EXACTLY 13 additional.
why: Two independent printed counts (3 at 10^9, 13 at 10^8) both land exactly on the mean+SD reading and neither lands on the bar-top reading. That is a resolution, not a coincidence -- but it means every potency count in the text is a mean+SD count while the corpus stores means.

locus_B: Table S1's first entry is code 60, which is below 80. The table has 29 rows including it.
third_witness: Figure 2A's first heatmap row is labelled 60; Figure 1B's first drawn head is labelled 60.

claim: The identity of the PEG lipid
locus_A: Methods, TNS assay / formulation sentence: '2.5 mol% C14-PEG2000'.
locus_B: Methods, 'LNP fabrication': 'PEG2000 (14:0 PEG2000 PE) from Avanti Polar Lipids'. 14:0 PEG2000 PE is DMPE-PEG2000, a phosphoETHANOLAMINE.
third_witness: In the corpus these are different molecules: 'C14-PEG2000' (480 rows) carries the DMG diglyceride string with no P and no N.
we_emitted: DMPE-PEG2000, with the phosphoethanolamine structure the chemical name requires.
why: '14:0 PEG2000 PE' is an unambiguous Avanti catalogue name and is the more specific of the two statements. SEPARATELY: the shared reagent guard REFUSES this name, because the corpus itself carries two structures for it -- 3,611 rows with the phosphoethanolamine and 1,873 JW_2024 rows with the diglyceride. That is open finding F-049 and is NOT repaired here.

claim: Every one of the 580 members is a single named compound
locus_A: Methods: 'Stoichiometric ratio of 1:4 was used', and Figure 1A draws '+ 4' acrylate for head 306, which has exactly 4 N-H.
locus_B: Five heads have MORE than 4 N-H -- 174 and 200 have 5, 110 and 122 have 6, 111 has 7 (counted by RDKit on the Table S1 structures, not by eye). Four equivalents cannot fully substitute them, so those 100 products are necessarily under-substituted mixtures.
third_witness: The corpus's own precedent for this chemistry (AA_2008, KL_2010, KW_2014) stores the fully substituted structure regardless.
we_emitted: the fully substituted structure, with confidence=low and structure_assumed=1 on all 100. 8 of the 49 emitted rows are affected.
why: Following the corpus precedent keeps the column comparable, but it is an assumption the paper's own stoichiometry contradicts. DECISIONS.md D-2.

claim: Abstract: 'a library of 580 ionizable lipidoids', of which 'over 40 enabled protein expression'
locus_B: Results: 'Based on TNS assessment, we selected 49 LNPs for in vivo study.' Only those 49 were ever given to an animal; the other 531 have a TNS value and nothing else.
we_emitted: 49 rows, and the intake gate states the 531 have no delivery value.
why: The '40' is of 49, not of 580. Both numbers are true; read quickly the sentence implies a 580-member hit rate of 7% when the tested hit rate is ~90%.

claim: Tail Oi10 is a single compound
locus_A: Table S2: 'Oi10 / Isodecyl Acrylate / Sigma'. Isodecyl acrylate (CAS 1330-61-6) is sold as a BRANCHED-ISOMER MIXTURE.
locus_B: Figure 1A and Figure 1C both draw one specific isomer, 8-methylnonyl, with a terminal isopropyl.
third_witness: CLAUDE.md section 6 already lists 'the exact branch of iso-decyl acrylate' as unverifiable from the paper; ZT_2026 flagged the same reagent.
we_emitted: the 8-methylnonyl isomer the figure draws, with structure_assumed=1 on all 29 Oi10 members.
why: The drawing is the paper's own statement; the vendor's is a mixture. Flagged rather than resolved.

locus_A: Table S2 names it '3,7,11,15-Tetramethyl-2-Hexadecenyl Acrylate' with NO cis/trans, while every other X entry states one (X1 cis, X2 trans, X3 trans, X5 trans, X6 cis, X7 cis).

claim: NOT A CONTRADICTION, recorded so its absence is visible: head 516's but-2-ene geometry
locus_A: Table S1 names it 'N1,N1'-(but-2-ene-1,4-diyl)bis(N1-ethylethane-1,2-diamine)' with no E/Z.
